diagnosis.description: Native omission of modelProviders filters to the configured default provider. RuntimeService omitted it, hiding persisted threads created with another enabled or subsequently removed provider.
diagnosis.resolution: Send fixed modelProviders: [] while retaining cwd/source/archive/search/sort/limit/cursor validation.

diagnosis.description: Actual official CLI returned an empty persistent list before first input and immediately after accepted first turns while loopback responses were deliberately held. Completion made the two rows persistent.
diagnosis.resolution: Retain only acknowledged, non-ephemeral root-thread summaries in this runtime epoch. Add separate first-page liveData until native persistence is observed; do not replace native data/cursor.

changes: All-provider listing includes disabled/removed historical provider identities without changing execution admission.

2048-entry reservation capacity matches activity scale; accepted unindexed rows are not silently evicted. Each summary has an 8192-byte bound and clipped Unicode preview/name. First-page view is limited to 100 with liveDataTruncated true.

Lifecycle notifications remove closed/deleted/archived summaries, update status/name/provider, and runtime close clears the cache. Native persisted rows remove their corresponding summary on any page. No loaded-thread scan, resume, input replay or new inference occurs in listing.
Added selector native prerequisite mapping for the new real-CLI regression.

adjacentFlows.reviewStartNew: workflows.newReview routes through host.call(thread/start), hence the same acknowledged-creation cache.
adjacentFlows.automation: automation-scheduler routes through Dispatcher conversation/start then RuntimeService thread/start, hence the same cache.
adjacentFlows.fork: Actual complete-history and empty-history fork replies precede persistent visibility. workflowMutation.newThread now reserves before dispatch and captures only its positive creation response, preserving identity/cwd guards and existing acknowledgement failure classification.
adjacentFlows.agents: Official relation-filter thread/list intentionally has no default provider filter even when omitted. Existing ancestor/cwd/source and response validation remain unchanged.
adjacentFlows.search: Official ThreadSearchParams has no provider filter; existing separate text-search and cwd validation are unchanged. The new liveData bridge is the sidebar list contract, not native full-text indexing.

runs.note: Before product fix: genuine official CLI reproduces missing non-default-provider conversation.
Provider fix passed its assertion; new default-created_at pagination assertion exposed independent official CLI timezone cursor behavior. Portable service and selector passed.
Narrow diagnosis preserved matching native/service created_at pagination failure; no workaround applied.
Final product bytes: service 77 + live cache 8 + actual official native 1 passed; native pagination uses actual UI recency_at contract.
Final service test increment: 78 passed including rejected-creation reservation release and capacity/pending/epoch integration.
Adjacent fork reproduction: complete-history and empty-history forks were missing from native persistence immediately after their positive replies. Earlier assertions passed.
Final fork-integrated product: 118 passed (service 78, workflows 39, actual native 1). Both forks now visible through separate liveData with no extra inference.

evidenceBoundaries: Official native fixture uses isolated HOME/CODEX_HOME and two loopback Responses endpoints. All external proxies are blocked; no paid inference, external MCP, real credentials or online writes.

Actual native test covers accepted creation before input, first-turn pending visibility from a different client, eventual indexed deduplication, persisted all-provider enumeration after process restart and provider removal, project separation, actual UI recency_at pagination, archive visibility and ChildProcess close proof.
First attempted targeted command lacked explicit HARNESS_TEST_CODEX_BIN and did not execute tests; corrected command explicitly selected the verified official binary.
limitations: The bridge is in-memory for the current runtime epoch. It survives browser reload, not a native process crash before native persistence. No false durability claim.

More than 100 matching live summaries are retained but the first-page view warns of truncation. At 2048 unindexed entries plus reservations, new creation is rejected before dispatch until summaries reconcile or close.

An additional native-only Windows created_at pagination probe returned a timezone-shifted nextCursor (local hour encoded as UTC) and lost the other same-second row. This is upstream behavior outside the actual sidebar recency_at path; original failed evidence and exact responses are retained. The production fix does not claim to repair that upstream sort.

Only affected tests and server type checking ran; not a full audit, whole test suite, deployment or Linux fixture. UI changes and the other agent provider-switch fixture are not authored by this report.
